name: YO Protocol
rootCause: YO Protocol is publicly catalogued as a 13 January 2026 Ethereum exploit with a reported $3.6 million loss, but the available evidence stops at the catalogue entry and protocol documentation. No transaction trace, official incident disclosure, or verified vulnerable code was available to reconstruct the exploit path. The public record classifies the incident as a missing slippage check, but no transaction trace or historical code excerpt was available to confirm the exact failing function or execution path.
